freePlan.limits: 1M analytics events, 5K session recordings, 1M feature flag requests, 100K exception events, 1,500 survey responses, 1M data warehouse rows + free historical data, 10K events + 1M rows for data pipelines, 100K AI observability events, 10 GB ingested logs, all reset monthly.

keyLimits.en: Generous monthly free allowances across every product (analytics, replay, feature flags, error tracking, surveys, data warehouse, pipelines, AI observability, logs); no payment method required until limits are exceeded.
Usage-based pricing kicks in once free monthly allowances are exceeded, billed per unit consumed per product; exact per-unit rates were not itemized on the page checked.

cautions.en: PostHog bundles many separate products (analytics, session replay, feature flags, error tracking, surveys, data warehouse, data pipelines, AI observability, logs) each with its own free allowance and usage-based overage pricing, so total cost depends on which products are used, not a single flat rate.

capabilities.en: Product analytics with event tracking, funnels and dashboards.
Error tracking, surveys, a data warehouse, data pipelines, AI observability and log ingestion as additional bundled products.

limitations.en: Free monthly allowances vary widely by product and reset monthly, which can make total cost estimation complex for teams using several PostHog products at once.
Exact pay-as-you-go per-unit overage rates were not itemized on the pricing page checked and require deeper review of the pricing calculator.

reason.en: Direct product analytics competitor with events, funnels and a comparable free tier.
Product analytics platform covering similar event tracking and experimentation use cases.
Lighter-weight, privacy-focused analytics alternative for teams that don't need PostHog's full product suite.

unknowns: Exact pay-as-you-go per-unit prices for each product (analytics events, replay recordings, etc.) beyond the free allowance were not detailed on the pricing page checked.
